4. Respondent No.2 is physically present in Court while Petitioner has joined virtually.

sentences.text: Learned APP, on the other hand, submits that another FIR has been registered against the Petitioner under Section 354 IPC, which has not been disclosed in the present petition.
It is also stated that there is no written agreement of settlement between the parties and thus the terms of settlement are unclear.

It is thus urged that in the absence of a Settlement Deed and in view of the non-disclosure of another FIR registered against the Petitioner, present FIR should not be quashed,
at this stage.

6. Learned counsel for the Petitioner, on instructions, seeks permission to withdraw the present petition with liberty to file a fresh petition after a written agreement, incorporating the terms of settlement between the Petitioner and Respondent No.2, has been executed.
7. Petition stands disposed of as withdrawn with liberty as prayed, in accordance with law.
JYOTI SINGH, J JANUARY 15, 2024/DU/kks
